name: search-and-bulk-replace
description: Multi-tool workflow: grep to find all 'spillover' references in ShellTool.swift, then edit_file with replace_all to rename them to 'overflow'. Tests grep + edit_file(replace_all) pipeline.
task: In Sources/Yrden/Tools/ShellTool.swift, there are multiple references to 'spillover' — including the property 'spilloverDirectory', the function 'writeSpillover', the parameter name 'spilloverDirectory', and comments mentioning 'spillover'. Rename ALL of these to use 'overflow' instead: 'spilloverDirectory' becomes 'overflowDirectory', 'writeSpillover' becomes 'writeOverflow', and comments should say 'overflow' instead of 'spillover'. Make sure every occurrence is updated.
